The bit duration is inferred from the nominal D2R bandwidth (15 kHz = 4/T_bit gives 2 tau; 2880 kHz gives tau/96). Without the S scaling A1-3/A1-4 would give 205.

9A Msg3: 96+CRC16 = 112 bits, x3 FEC = 336, 7 midambles + preamble = 584 bits at 2 tau = 155733.3 us

9A Msg1: Random ID is 16 bits (38.391 §6.2.2.1), so CRC6 by the A>24 rule: 22 bits, x3 = 66, one midamble: 128 bits = 34133.3 us. With CRC16 it would be 189 bits = 50400 us, which does not fit T2 = 35 ms, so the 35 ms figure supports the CRC6 reading. Table 9A.2.2-3 lists 'CRC 16' without saying which message.
